Mathematics BSc at University of Manchester

What University of Manchester asks of applicants to Mathematics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Manchester courses · Mathematics field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 3 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US High School Diploma from an accredited US school: Manchester typically requires the equivalent of three A-levels plus GCSE English and Mathematics/Science
  • SAT I 1290 or ACT 27 is listed as one way to meet the GCSE-equivalent part (alternatively the High School Diploma with a minimum 3.0 and grade 12 classes at the GCSE grade equivalent)
  • SAT/ACT is not listed as meeting the A-level part — that is met with three AP tests or dual-enrolment/college-level classes in separate subjects, plus the High School Diploma (GPA 3.0)

University-wide guidance only; the course page points to the Department of Mathematics’ country page, which is published for September 2026 entry and lists a High School Diploma plus APs, with no SAT/ACT.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Manchester: Information for students from the US · Manchester: Mathematics – Country-specific information
English language
  • IELTS Academic or UKVI: 6.5 overall, no sub-skill below 6.0 (in-person tests only)
  • TOEFL iBT: 90 overall, nothing below 20 (Special Home Edition not accepted)
  • GCSE/IGCSE English Language grade C/4

Other qualifications
